title: Hiring and firing
summary: Greene says he stays away from who is hired and fired.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: I wonder why that did come apart? Do you know? Do you remember even? Why did it end?
Or, was it just one of those things?
I really don't remember. I don't remember did what happened there.
Like -- you know -- like, most of the people that would be with the band -- they left -- I remember -- half of the time I don't know what's going on. I mean, as far as hiring and firing.
You know -- I'm not -- (laugh) I stay away from -- all that -- I stay away from it, you know.
But, you must be aware of -- in a way -- like, when Lockjaw & Eric Dixon were having their --
You were actually aware of that?
Yeah. You just don't -- that's not a part of things that --
No. I don't like that part of the game, more or less.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, that's like the personal end of things.
